positive_snippets: Ms. Fiza is very soft and handled things properly. Mr. Digvinay is also done the process of check in & check out very smoothly. All staffs are in friendly and having helping nature. Definitely will come back.

negative_snippets:
I am extremely upset with this property. They charge a very high amount but provide absolutely no proper facilities or service. It is a pathetic hotel.

The gym is located on the top floor, and loud music plays from 5:00 AM until 12:00 PM. On top of that, the sound of gym equipment continues from 5:00 PM until 12:30 AM. It is impossible to sleep due to the constant noise.

Room service is very poor. The bedsheets and blankets were dirty and had a bad smell. There was no hot water, and sometimes not even normal running water. The towels were dirty as well.

Overall, it was a very bad experience. The management seems new and unable to handle guest complaints or resolve issues properly.

I strongly recommend avoiding this hotel.
